resumen.nota: Sentences generated by rules from the run's data; each one points to its figure.
fig.especies: Bots per species ({n#the largest|the {n} largest}), stacked. Dashed lines mark the summary's findings.
fig.especiesOtras: Bots per species ({n#the largest|the {n} largest} and "others"), stacked. Dashed lines mark the summary's findings.
grupo.sinDatos: No data for this group in the run.
banda: The shaded band spans the minimum to the maximum of the samples each point merges.
fig.total: Total living bots, vegetables and non-vegetables.
fig.adn: Mean DNA length, in instructions per bot.
fig.nacimientos: Births and deaths per sample (every {intervalo} {intervalo#cycle|cycles}), adding up all species.
fig.disparos: Shots by type per sample (every {intervalo} {intervalo#cycle|cycles}), stacked.
fig.histogramas: Distributions at cycle {ciclo} (one per panel, with the number of bots counted).
gen.resumen: {n} {n#species|species}: {raices} seeded or arrived from outside and {hijas} that arose during the run.
fig.genealogia: Species tree: each bar runs from the cycle the species appeared to the last one it had bots; × marks an extinction.
gen.fotosNota: Gene-by-gene comparison between the first snapshot of each species' dominant DNA and the last one.
pie.datos: Data embedded in this file: {puntos} {puntos#point|points} × {series} {series#series|series}, {eventos} {eventos#event|events} and the species tree.
hallazgo.dominio: {especie} made up more than {umbral} % of the population between cycles {desde} and {hasta} (up to {max} %).
hallazgo.colapso: The non-vegetable population fell {caida} % between cycles {desde} and {hasta}: from {de} to {a} {a#bot|bots}.
hallazgo.extincion: {especie} went extinct at cycle {ciclo}; its peak was {pico} {pico#bot|bots} at cycle {cicloPico}.
hallazgo.extincion.retorno: {especie} disappeared at cycle {ciclo} and came back at cycle {vuelve}; its peak was {pico} {pico#bot|bots}.
hallazgo.adn.crecimiento: DNA length in non-vegetable species grew {cambio} % (from {de} to {a} instructions on average, comparing each species with itself).
hallazgo.adn.reduccion: DNA length in non-vegetable species fell {cambio} % (from {de} to {a} instructions on average, comparing each species with itself).
evento.extincionVegetal: {especie} ran out of bots (vegetable: it is replenished)
evento.extincionVuelve: {especie} ran out of bots and came back later
hallazgo.extincion.intermitente: {especie} disappeared and came back {veces} {veces#time|times} between cycles {desde} and {hasta}.
hallazgo.extincion.intermitenteFin: {especie} disappeared and came back {veces} {veces#time|times} from cycle {desde} on, and went extinct at cycle {hasta}.
hallazgo.resto.dominio: Also, {n} more {n#period|periods} of dominance between cycles {desde} and {hasta}.
hallazgo.resto.colapso: Also, {n} more population {n#drop|drops} between cycles {desde} and {hasta}.
hallazgo.resto.extincion: Also, {n} more species {n#disappearance|disappearances} between cycles {desde} and {hasta}.
hallazgo.resto.adn: Also, {n} more DNA {n#change|changes} between cycles {desde} and {hasta}.
cmp.nDiferencias: {n} {n#difference|differences} at start or during the run (options are compared by their effective value: base plus changes).
cmp.sinDiferencias: Both runs have the same configuration.
fig.cmp: {metrica}: A as a solid line and B as a dashed line.
resumen.notaCmp: Sentences generated by rules from each run's data; each one points to its figure.
cmp.finalesNota: Last point of each run's history (cycle {a} in A and {b} in B). The difference is B − A.
pie.cmp: Data embedded in this file: {series} {series#series|series} from both runs, their configurations and their differences.
rep.parcial: {hechas} of {n} replicates finished: the results are partial.
rep.frase: {metrica} at the end: {media} ± {desvio} on average (between {min} and {max} over {n} {n#replicate|replicates}).
resumen.notaRep: Sentences generated by rules from the last sample of each replicate (mean ± standard deviation); each one points to its figure.
rep.caliente: Each replicate repeats {n} {n#live change|live changes} from the source run at the same cycle.
rep.sinCaliente: The source run had no live changes.
rep.c19: While choosing the seeds, {n#{n} seed that repeated an already used world was|{n} seeds that repeated an already used world were} skipped: the engine tells 65,536 worlds apart by seed, and two replicates of the same world would silently shrink the band and the deviation.
rep.bandasNota: At each cycle, the line is the mean of the replicates and the band goes from the 10th to the 90th percentile.
rep.tablaNota: Last sample of each replicate (cycle {ciclo}), unmerged; sample standard deviation.
pie.rep: Data embedded in this file: {series} aggregated {series#series|series}, the final table and the {n} {n#seed|seeds}.
objeto.forma: Random obstacle of {ancho} % × {alto} % of the field
objeto.formas: 10 random obstacles of {ancho} % × {alto} % of the field
